one_line: Issue tracking and project management designed for software teams.
auth_notes: GraphQL API authenticated via OAuth 2.0 or personal API keys; TypeScript SDK available; docs explicitly cover integrating AI agents.
self_serve_notes: Free tier available; personal API keys are self-service in workspace settings, no approval needed.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Full GraphQL schema over issues, cycles, projects, teams, comments, users, attachments; plus file uploads and CLI importer.

existing_mcp.note: Community MCP servers exist (e.g. sheriferson/linear-mcp-server); official Linear MCP not confirmed.

evidence.note: Fetched getting-started page confirms GraphQL API and OAuth 2.0 / personal API key auth.

agent_notes: Fetched text was short; API breadth based on knowledge of the GraphQL schema.
